## NSS interface monitoring not possible?

- Source: https://community.zscaler.com/s/question/0D54u00009nLJfiCAG/nss-interface-monitoring-not-possible
- Type: Q&A
- Last activity: 2023-07-24T05:20:18.000Z
- Note: ユーザー投稿であり Zscaler の公式見解ではない。内容が古い場合があるため投稿日を確認すること。

ZIA - Logging

Blubberlutsch

(Customer) asked a question.

July 18, 2023 at 1:56 PM

NSS interface monitoring not possible?

Hi all,

as there is no topic like monitoring, i am asking here.

I am monitoring our NSS servers using SNMP. And as there are no interface OIDs for the zscaler interfaces, the only interfaces seen in the standard linux interface table are em0, em1 and so on but not zs0, zs1.

So i don't see any way to see interface statistics like sent and received packets and so on.

Is there no way to achieve this?

Thanks in advance

Vince

ZIA - Logging

5 answers

641 views

GordonWright

(Customer)

3 years ago

I remember looking at this a while ago and didn't get a good solution.

You can always pull interface stats from the switch ..... I guess you can also do this in a cloud environment as well.

Blubberlutsch

(Customer)

3 years ago

I was afraid of such a question. We will set up an NSS in our own vCenter to at least see the statistics of the interfaces there.

In parallel, I'll wait and see if our TAM can find something out.

MikeRuiz

(Employee)

3 years ago

I've only done a quick test in the lab right now but it looks like there are private MIBs for enumerating the OS NICs as well as the ZS NICs.  However in the private OID tree it only enumerates them.  If you want stats, such as packets etc, then it appears the private MIBs do include MIB2 OIDs for IP, ICMP, TCP, and UDP which appears to be an aggregate of traffic in those protocol buckets but across all interfaces.

For example 1.3.6.1.2.1.6.10 is tcpInSegs and whether I move traffic over the management or service interface it increments.  Note that's a MIB2 OID.

Where 1.3.6.1.4.1.46262.2.2 is a table with OIDs for all the ZS NICs such as ZS0 and as you can tell from the OID this is in the private MIB base.

If you're really looking to understand traffic per interface up and down, you may have an easier time pulling it from the switch, vswitch, etc

MIBs are here:

https://help.zscaler.com/zia/accessing-zscaler-snmp-mibs

and this is the one I looked at primarily in poking on this in my lab  ZSCALER-ZSCALERNIC-MIB

## Limit user access - one concurrent user connected

- Source: https://community.zscaler.com/s/question/0D54u00009oUWpZCAW/limit-user-access-one-concurrent-user-connected
- Type: Q&A
- Last activity: 2023-07-24T08:56:57.000Z
- Note: ユーザー投稿であり Zscaler の公式見解ではない。内容が古い場合があるため投稿日を確認すること。

ZIA - Authentication

mohammad.rummaneh

(Partner) asked a question.

July 24, 2023 at 6:58 AM

Limit user access - one concurrent user connected

Dears ,

we have office connected to internet via Zscaler - ZIA over GRE tunnel .

is there anyway to let only one concurrent user can access the internet .

let us assume that an employee get credentials for another one , i need only ONE user access internet not both .

ZIA - Authentication

1 answer

539 views

mohammad.rummaneh

likes this.

GordonWright

(Customer)

3 years ago

Not sure there is an easy way to do this within the Zscaler itself. You could limit the number of machines a single user can register to one but that doesn't really fix your problem.

You could probably do something within your IDP platform. MFA is a good idea then they couldn't just give there username/password to someone else as it would require the second factor for authentication. I think you an also lock a particular user login to a single machine.

User education/training is also a key point here. Make it part of your code-of-conduct to not share user credentials.

Probably lots of things you can do in your SIEM tool as well to identify and perhaps automate alerting\blocking of this sort of behaviour.

- Type: Q&A

Community Highlights

Ben_Garrison

(Employee) asked a question.

August 7, 2023 at 4:11 PM

Community August Changelog

There will be many updates coming within the next two quarters. And we will ensure that you are updated as soon as releases happen!

We want to avoid accidentally using email addresses within the Nickname field, as this could expose PII to the public. Although this is a user setting, we are taking preventative measures to ensure a member does not accidentally enter this.

What’s changed?

Do not allow users to have ‘@’ in their username while registering for the community.

When auto-provisioned users are logged into the community for the first time, they should not be allowed to accept ToS and continue if there is an ‘@’ in their username.

When a user is updating their nickname from the community profile page, @ should not be allowed

Why was this change made?

To have valid usernames across the community

The email address is not displayed as a username

Hello @Arshad siddiquie​

Thank you for bringing this to our attention!

It looks like the errors you're experiencing may be related to issues with your SFTP server. We recommend that you review the guidance on configuring DLP application integration using Azure to ensure everything is set up correctly. You can find the detailed instructions here:

https://help.zscaler.com/workflow-automation/configuring-dlp-application-integration-using-azure

Additionally, I suggest reaching out to Azure Support for further assistance. They can investigate the server side and provide insights on what might be happening.

I hope this information is helpful! If you need anything further, please let us know.

devinmarco

(Customer) asked a question.

September 14, 2023 at 11:10 AM

How Zscaler Facilitated Edge Computing for a Global Enterprise

Hi Everyone

Edge computing is a distributed IT architecture that brings computing and data storage closer to the end users. This can improve performance, reduce latency, and increase security. Zscaler is a cloud security company that offers a global edge computing platform.

One example of how Zscaler has facilitated

edge computing

for a global enterprise is with a large financial services company. This company has offices in over 50 countries and needs to provide its employees with secure access to applications and data regardless of location.

Zscaler's global edge computing platform enabled the company to deploy a secure and scalable solution that met its needs. Zscaler's security services are delivered from its cloud data centers, which are located in over 150 countries. This means that employees can access applications and data from anywhere in the world with low latency and high security.

Here are some of the specific ways that Zscaler helped the financial services company to implement edge computing:

Reduced latency:

Zscaler's global network provides the shortest path between users and applications, which reduces latency and improves performance.

Increased security:

Zscaler's security services are delivered from the edge, which means that threats are detected and blocked closer to the user. This helps to protect applications and data from cyberattacks.

Simplified management:

Zscaler's cloud-based platform makes it easy to manage security policies and deploy new applications.

Overall, Zscaler's global edge computing platform helped the financial services company to improve performance, security, and scalability.

Additional discussion points:

What are the benefits of edge computing for global enterprises?

What are some of the challenges of implementing edge computing?

How can Zscaler help enterprises to overcome these challenges?

What are some other examples of how Zscaler has facilitated edge computing for global enterprises?

Thank You

Community Highlights

1 answer

416 views

GordonWright

(Customer)

3 years ago

Not sure I agree with all of that.

I wouldn't call Zscaler an Edge Compute capability but  Cloud Compute. Zscaler's strategy means you do not have to deploy compute power on your network edge but use the power and flexibility of their cloud.

I also wouldn't say that Zscaler's global network provides the shortest path between users and applications. There is nothing shorter than a straight line between user and application and adding Zscaler in the middle increases the path length and network latency. Overall adding Zscaler might improve performance for lots of reasons though.

I 100% agree with the increased security (although it depends what you came from)  and the simplified management.

Hi Rahul,

When you moved to Azure AD to did you opt to use SCIM provisioning?  We did the same thing and moved from ADFS with SAML Auto Provisioning to Entra ID (Then Azure AD) with SCIM auto provisioning.

One of the main advantages with SCIM is it's ability to delete users as well, where as SAML auto provisioning could only create.

Anyway,  In your Zscaler Enterprise App in Entra ID have you added these groups to the "Users and groups" section?  As by default the app provisions users and groups from there.

Thats correct.  You need to ensure that your groups are sync'ing from on premise AD to Entra ID. ## GWLB - Distribured GWLB endpoints and centralised Egress

- Source: https://community.zscaler.com/s/question/0D54u0000A57pOQCQY/gwlb-distribured-gwlb-endpoints-and-centralised-egress
- Type: Q&A
- Last activity: 2023-10-18T22:14:09.000Z
- Note: ユーザー投稿であり Zscaler の公式見解ではない。内容が古い場合があるため投稿日を確認すること。

Cloud Connector

bsashank

(Customer) asked a question.

October 17, 2023 at 6:50 PM

GWLB - Distribured GWLB endpoints and centralised Egress

Hello Team -

Hope you are doing well. I am trying to understand the packet flow for the pattern in AWS where the workload/spoke VPCs send traffic to Zscaler proxy using distributed GWLB endpoints.

Source - https://www.zscaler.com/resources/reference-architectures/zero-trust-security-for-aws-workloads.pdf ( Use case - Distributed Gateway Load-Balancing Endpoint)

As i understand the egress to internet is initiated by the instance in workload VPC and the packet will flow like -

Instance -> GWLB Endpoint -> (AWS Private Link)- >GWLB -> (GENEVE) -> Zscaler Cloud Connector Instance -> NAT Gateway -> IGW -> Zscaler Edge

Now how does the return packter get routed to the instance? I am not clear on how the GWLB is able to route the packet to the original GWLB endpoint which might be in a completely different VPC than the Zscaler VPC.

Any help on this is appreciated.

Cloud Connector

1 answer

457 views

ozanogur

likes this.

Aaron_Rohyans

(Employee)

3 years ago

Hello -

This information is maintained in the GENEVE header. The Cloud Connector processes and stores this header information in a state table (of sorts) when the original flow is sent. When the return flow comes back, Cloud Connector  forwards the flow back to the GWLB with the correct GENEVE header/session info. The GWLB identifies which session the flow belongs to based on the headers passed back to it from the Cloud Connector.

AWS has internal logic (based on this header info) to ensure this traffic makes its way back to the originating GWLB endpoint and, ultimately, back to the instance the flow originated from.

Here are some helpful links that explain this logic:

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/gateway/introduction.html

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpce-gateway-load-balancer.html

https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8926#name-geneve-packet-format-over-i

Hope this helps,

Aaron

## Windows 365 Cloud PC Disconnecting on first login after reboot

- Type: Q&A
- Last activity: 2024-10-22T07:20:13.000Z

Swartzendruber.travis

(Customer) asked a question.

November 20, 2023 at 5:19 PM

Windows 365 Cloud PC Disconnecting on first login after reboot

We are seeing that after a reboot when you first log into your Windows 365 Cloud PC (CPC) you will see a short disconnect and reconnect (sometimes you have to click connect again). When this happens, we can see the screen freeze and ZIA enabled is the last popup. We can see in Network Traces that it does seem to be ZIA causing this.

I have found

this post

of a very similar question (but with AVD). We have already implemented the steps provided in the blog post, we also got the same post from Microsoft. But this does not seem to work.

Anyone else see this and fixed it?

ZIA - Authentication

4 answers

2.9K views

User16299917802863753937

likes this.

G-Man8

(Customer)

3 years ago

Hi,

We had to ask Zscaler to increase our IPV4 bypasses limit to accommodate all the IP's.

I stand to be corrected but I believe Zscaler approach is for Windows 365 to use/test ZCC 4.3 using

Process bypass

option but I havent managed to fully test it.

I know ZCC 4.3 is not GA but would you consider testing and share ?

1 like

Mike-CyberHntr

(Customer)

3 years ago

We had this issue for a while.  Finally we added 169.254.169.254 and 168.63.129.16 and the 265 Gateway Bypasses to the Hostname or IP Address Bypass for VPN Gateways under the App Profile that we were using for AVDs.  Initially they told us to add those under the Destination Exclusions for IPv4 and it worked for some but not others, so then we tried it under the Bypass for VPN Gateways and it seems to work well.  The character limit for the Bypass VPN Gateways is higher too.  There are over 7,000 characters in all of the Microsoft Gateways subnets.  Maybe Zscaler will add the feature of just adding *.

wvd.microsoft.com

into the Bypass VPN Gateway field.

<!-- ZS-POST {"url":"https://community.zscaler.com/s/question/0D54u0000ABJZSCCQ5/cacpiv-issues","lastmod":"2023-12-06T19:22:46.000Z","id":"0D54u0000ABJZSCCQ5"} -->
## CAC/PIV Issues

- Source: https://community.zscaler.com/s/question/0D54u0000ABJZSCCQ5/cacpiv-issues
- Type: Q&A
- Last activity: 2023-12-06T19:22:46.000Z
- Note: ユーザー投稿であり Zscaler の公式見解ではない。内容が古い場合があるため投稿日を確認すること。

ZIA - Authentication

jimerb

(Customer) asked a question.

November 30, 2023 at 6:22 PM

CAC/PIV Issues

Anyone having issues with ZCC and users with CAC (common access card)? We have several users experiencing intermittent issues navigating to sites that are CAC enabled. Navigating to a URL simply times out, but the user is never prompted for their CAC. Other times it works without issue. I've had several tickets opened, but haven't been able to arrive at a solution.

ZIA - Authentication

1 answer

620 views

CKAIJA

(Employee)

3 years ago

I have faced this issue in two use cases:

First Use case --- Internal Employees that are active duty military with CAC cards to access Government based sites, download orders, travel papers, etc . ---- Solution was this all of these types of users we placed in a known Active Directory Security Group and wrote a policy that allowed non-std ports in the Zscaler Advanced firewall, and URL access to MAIL servers for the this group of users. This allowed us to monitor the traffic outbound but not intercept it as by policy we did not inspect MIL / GOV/ FIN/ Health style sites.

Second Use case ----- System level Application access for Users and servers over to a Secure Gov't IP network  range reserved for a specific three letter agency, this was more cut and dry, as we set the specific range to bypass, as the servers did not participate in normal user tracking and logging methods.  So the site determined that monitoring that range was not required due to the transactional security layered on the access and it was never allowed outside the building

Your biggest question is determine what the CAC needs  non standard ports, certs, maybe a neatwork range to operate properly, you may also run into an issue where the Domain policies attempt to pass the logged in users base credentials which also will never work so tell your end users to try this in Incognito or In-Private Browsing , this may give you more insight to where the catch is since it is a CAC -- I would look heavily at your SSL set up and as the possible issue most applications levering CAC may use internal or self signed certs, so you may need to rule that out or allow this site to pass

We recently migrated from using a hosted DB using ADFS for user management, to using Azure AD as our IDP. We then set up SCIM provisioning so that the user management database can be automatically updated.

We're running into an issue with the existing user accounts. Since being on ADFS to start, the max group membership is 128. SCIM is supposed to fix that issue if the user accounts are being updated, but it doesn't appear the actual user accounts are being touched, it's just syncing groups.

What are we missing here so that it updates existing user accounts and reflects their current groups? Thanks.

## ZScaler Okta SAML SCIM Setup

- Source: https://community.zscaler.com/s/question/0D54u0000AELRzZCQX/zscaler-okta-saml-scim-setup
- Type: Q&A
- Last activity: 2025-10-28T20:45:30.000Z
- Note: ユーザー投稿であり Zscaler の公式見解ではない。内容が古い場合があるため投稿日を確認すること。

ZIA - Authentication

juan

(Customer) asked a question.

December 27, 2023 at 5:30 PM

ZScaler Okta SAML SCIM Setup

We are an Okta shop.

We are setup for SCIM with ZScaler, but have noticed that the department attribute does not populate in ZScaler user management.

In ZScaler, under the IDP settings, we have both "Enable SAML Auto-Provisioning" and "Enable SCIM Provisioning' checked even though the documentation says to check only "Enable SCIM Provisioning".

We have tried unchecking "Enable SAML Auto-Provisioning", but if a new user attempts to sign into ZScaler without it checked, they cannot log in. They receive an error stating "There was an issue verifying your identity within our system. Please try authenticating again. Error Codes: 0xe5621 | IdP: 0x83c | CA5204".

I tried looking up the error codes here (https://help.zscaler.com/zcspm/troubleshooting-saml), but it isn't very helpful.

Our users are set to sign in once then never again, so the attributes don't update because they only sign in once with SAML which is why we opted for SCIM, but it does not seem to be working.

Does anyone have a working ZScaler Okta SCIM setup? Is there anything special you needed to do to get your setup running properly?

ZIA - Authentication

9 months ago

## Unable to access shared folders via Zscaler

- Source: https://community.zscaler.com/s/question/0D54u0000AFRuJnCQL/unable-to-access-shared-folders-via-zscaler
- Type: Q&A
- Last activity: 2024-01-16T16:42:56.000Z
- Note: ユーザー投稿であり Zscaler の公式見解ではない。内容が古い場合があるため投稿日を確認すること。

ZPA - Privileged Remote Access

stevensheldon

(Customer) asked a question.

January 11, 2024 at 2:24 PM

Unable to access shared folders via Zscaler

Hello all,

A few months ago our company switched from another VPN solution to Zscaler. It worked great and was faster and did not require us to use our key cards to log in - it just automatically connects every time you boot up which is nice.

Everything worked fine for a while but about a month ago I could no longer access shared drives on computers back in the office (while working from home). This used to work fine.

I can Remote Desktop into the same machines, and my web browser connects to our in-house web-based tools without issue. It is only shared drives I cannot hit anymore.

Our IT folks don't seem to know the solution and have us go back to the old VPN solution, which works but is slower and not as convenient.

Can anyone suggest anything I could pass along to our IT folks?

Thanks,

ZPA - Privileged Remote Access

11 answers

4.03K views

G-Man8

(Customer)

3 years ago

Hi Steven,

If your not seeing any blocks or failed attempts in ZPA console then it sounds like our friend 'Windows client Firewall'. We had similar issues as normally VPN triggers a 'network change' which switches the Windows client FW to 'DomainAuthenticated' rather than Public or Private. This all depends on your config but worth checking as 'Public' normally blocked SMB access constantly for us.

Using this PS command is a nice way to query the state "Get-NetConnectionProfile | Format-List"

Please share your findings

Thank you

Regards

Gerhard

G-Man8

(Customer)

3 years ago

Hi Steven,

No I need to apologise, I skimmed your 'problem statement'.

So the issue is you can no longer access  the shared drives of the desktops running in the office.

Not knowing your infrastructure it can be several things:

1) You no longer have administrator rights on the desktops but only a member of the 'remote desktop' group.

2) It can also be that someone has disabled or restricted access to the

client-to-client

feature within Zscaler.

3) Your desktops might have changed from being Active Directory joined Azure Active directory joined which requires you to upgrade the Zscaler client to utilise the client-to-client feature.

That's all I can suggest to your IT folks I'm afraid

Regards

Gerhard

Some new information:

But I could not hit shared folders on my desktop machines in the office.  Even c$.  These used to work.

However, I also discovered that I cannot ping those desktop machines, either by partial or fully qualified domain name.  However, I

can

ping them by IP address!

Likewise, if I try to access the share through IP address

\\00.00.00.00\c$

this works fine to access the drives.  But it does not work via domain name (fully qualified or not).

This implies some kind of DNS issue?

Thanks,

G-Man8

(Customer)

3 years ago

Hi Steven,

Good that Corporate Fileserver access works :)

Using 'Private Access' (ZPA) doesn't allow ping or DNS resolve as part of the Zero Trust Architecture. (You'll get synthetic IP's of 100.64.* . *)

ZPA ignores IP's so you are most likely getting the ping reply due to your VPN connection.

Is your corporate server (

corporateserver.siemens.net

)  in the same domain level as your desktops (

yourdesktop.siemens.net

) ?

Have a great weekend

G-Man8

(Customer)

3 years ago

Hi Steven,

No Zscaler client (ZCC) is not required.

Is your corporate server (

corporateserver.siemens.net

) in the same domain level as your desktops (

yourdesktop.siemens.net

) ?

In Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) we allow or block access based on the FQDN and port. Hence my question, so you can access the file share of your corporate server (

ad001.siemens.net

) BUT ZPA can block access OR ignore your request officecomputer.siemens

.com

Your IT  guys should be able to confirm this.

A nice way to confirm if your FQDN request is being ignored is to try and ping your desktop in the office. Example...if you "ping

ad001.siemens.net

" you'll get an IP of 100.64.*.* (

your Request timed out

)  BUT if you try to ping your desktop in the office using ZPA....do you still get 100.64.*.* (your Request timed out) OR nothing ?

## Changing of the NameID but same login credential

- Source: https://community.zscaler.com/s/question/0D54u0000AGOwrpCQD/changing-of-the-nameid-but-same-login-credential
- Type: Q&A
- Last activity: 2025-10-31T21:09:48.000Z
- Note: ユーザー投稿であり Zscaler の公式見解ではない。内容が古い場合があるため投稿日を確認すること。

ZIA - Authentication

Ohhlala79

(Customer) asked a question.

January 20, 2024 at 1:44 AM

Changing of the NameID but same login credential

We are doing an exercise of changing user UPN name ( nameid) but all users and the login crednetial remain the same. I would like to know the behavior of the users that are already login with the device tag to old UPN name in ZIA.

Will the new upn get auto update on ZCC portal? Or when ZPA re-authenticate, it will update for ZPA and ZIA new upn?

Will there be disruption when the UPN name changed?

ZIA - Authentication

1 answer

677 views

Armando

(Employee)

9 months ago

Hi @Francis Tan​ When the UPN changes, ZCC does not automatically update the UPN in the portal.

The new UPN will update in ZPA and ZIA during the next re-authentication.

There may be a brief disruption if re-authentication is required, but users should reconnect seamlessly once updated. Ensure proper synchronization with your IdP to avoid delays.

Thanks.

Hello Community members,

We're excited to announce the launch of our new and improved federated search! We've been listening to your feedback and have made some big changes.

For those who might be unfamiliar, federated search is a way to search multiple databases or internet sites simultaneously. This means you can now search the community, Zscaler website, help documentation, and even YouTube for Zscaler content, all from one place right here on our Community!

This new feature will greatly enhance your experience here on our community. The benefits of federated search include more efficient searching, saving you time and effort. You'll be able to find the content you're looking for faster and more accurately than ever before.

We value your feedback and would love to hear your thoughts on this new feature. Please let us know how it's working for you and if there's anything else we can do to improve your experience here on our Community.

Thank you for being a valued member of the Zscaler Zenith Community!

Ben_Garrison

(Employee) asked a question.

Edited February 4, 2024 at 3:45 PM

Zenith Community: New Design Enhancements and Dark Mode Feature

Hello Community Members!

Over the past several months, we've gathered valuable feedback from our community and influencers about the user experience on the Zenith Community. This feedback inspired us to incorporate elements of our previous platform's design into our current one, leading to several key enhancements.

We've reduced the header size so you can access content faster.

Relocated the featured content to the side area.

Moved category navigation to the right-hand widget area for easier navigation.

Decreased the overall header height.

The improved search feature allows you to find answers and resources more quickly.

Added more content to the activity area, making recent discussions more visible.

Made numerous other UI/UX improvements.

Lats but not least… DARK MODE!

Dark mode was a highly requested feature, popular on our previous platform. The majority of our members used the dark mode theme.

How To Enable Dark Mode

Log into the community (this is necessary as it's a user setting).

Click on your avatar in the top right corner of the site.

Go to My Settings → Toggle the Dark Mode feature.

We're thrilled about these enhancements and eager to hear your feedback. What do you think of the new design and the dark mode feature? Let us know!

ZPA - SSL Inspection

Dasarathi

(Customer) asked a question.

February 26, 2024 at 2:08 PM

Getting Zscaller certificate error  when access URL in edge browser

When try to access some public URL in edge blog search or edge browser getting some certificate error but same site able to open in chrome browser without any certificate error page.

ZPA - SSL Inspection

2 answers

940 views

manuel

(Customer)

2 years ago

Hello Dasarathi,

I am sorry, but your error description is missing details. What error exactly do you face? What certificate is shown in the error message? What version of ZCC are you using? Did you check the Zscaler RCA certificate is deployed correctly in the Windows Certificate Store? Maybe there is an issue with the handling of certs, as Edge has a different approach of certificate handling than some other browsers, see also

https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/deployedge/microsoft-edge-security-cert-verification

. Usually there is no impact for the enduser, but I would make sure to check also the Edge Certificate store (in settings of Edge).

BR

Manuel

## Migration of on-prem ADFS to Azure AD

- Source: https://community.zscaler.com/s/question/0D54u0000AOD1EmCQL/migration-of-onprem-adfs-to-azure-ad
- Type: Q&A
- Last activity: 2024-03-20T13:54:01.000Z
- Note: ユーザー投稿であり Zscaler の公式見解ではない。内容が古い場合があるため投稿日を確認すること。

ZIA - Authentication

ent.support

(Customer) asked a question.

March 20, 2024 at 6:25 AM

Migration of on-prem ADFS to Azure AD

Planning to migrate AD authentication from on-prem ADFS to Azure AD.

Auth interval is to set to never expiry ->

Please confirm is there any impact?

ZIA - Authentication

1 answer

516 views

Ben_Garrison

(Employee)

2 years ago

If you have SSO setup with Zscaler you may need to update your certs or SSO configuration.  Just thinking outloud from an SSO perspective. More than likely you'll be using AD Sync to get the identities over (if not already present). Once that bridge is severed, you can then point SSO to Azure AD and everything should be pretty seamless.

I guess the better question would be, do you have any ZIA/ZPA profiles that might be effected?

My question is on the CPEs, as I am not clear how to show the fact that I have effectively perform these activities to allow ISC2 to grant me the CPEs for my CISSP renewal.

Moreover, for what concerns EDU-200 and EDU-202 labs and exams, from the Academy website I see that they should provide 30 CPEs, which is a very high number, so I am prone to believe that this is an error:

Can anyone from the Zscaler Academy team clarify the matter?

Hopefully this can also be useful to other Zscaler technicians who can benefit from the CPEs accrued during the Zscaler Academy trainings.

Many thanks,

Luca Bertagnolio

**NEW** Community Achievements and Leaderboards

We are happy to announce our community achievements program. This is designed to recognize and celebrate your engagement and activity within the community. You will be able to earn badges, reputation, and achievements.

We will begin deployment on Saturday, April 27th at 7:30PM PT

Starting on Sunday, April 28th at 2:30AM PT, you will be able to enjoy:

Leaderboards

showcasing our top contributors.

Missions

which will help you earn new badges.

Activity awards

for liking, commenting on topics and posts.

Reputation points

to highlight your contributions as a reliable source.

You will earn reputation by posting topics, commenting, receiving likes, and being an active member of the community. We have 13 ranks starting at Copper I and going all the way to Champion. We will add more information about the ranks soon.

Missions will provide specific badges for completing actions, such as updating your profile or engaging with certain posts.

Commenting, liking, or posting new topics, you will earn achievements to showcase your active participation.

Badges will be earned through various activities, both in and outside of our community. Whether you attend Zenith Live or earn a new certification, there are badges to be earned.

We have more to come after launch, including incorporating swag and redeemable items earned via badges and achievements. So be sure to keep checking back for those updates.

We hope you enjoy this new feature and look forward to hearing your feedback and your engagement!

## unmanaged devices - limit connection to every restart

- Source: https://community.zscaler.com/s/question/0D54u0000ATG5TBCQ1/unmanaged-devices-limit-connection-to-every-restart
- Type: Q&A
- Last activity: 2024-05-28T11:10:10.000Z
- Note: ユーザー投稿であり Zscaler の公式見解ではない。内容が古い場合があるため投稿日を確認すること。

ZPA - Authentication

SharonCM

(Partner) asked a question.

May 20, 2024 at 10:32 PM

unmanaged devices - limit connection to every restart

When we install the agent on unmanaged device, it gets username and password authentication.

How can we limit the connection to 1 time, and every restart or disconnect he will need to enter his credentials?

Limitation of timeout – can we set it to every restart the agent will need to login?

ZPA - Authentication

3 answers

351 views

saquibrais09

likes this.

G-Man8

(Customer)

2 years ago

Hi Sharon.

Do you only want this daily timeout policy to apply to unmanaged devices?

Are you using the additional

SAML attributes

of "is_device_compliant", "is_device_known" and "is_device_managed" ?

We use EntraID as our idp with a predefined timeout of x hours.

We've configured a ZPA 'AUTHENTICATION TIMEOUT' of x hours along with App Profile option of 'FORCE ZPA AUTHENTICATION TO EXPIRE' on 'SYSTEM RESTART'.

This ensures our ZPA users always need to re-authenticate fully !

BUT the App Profile option does create some additional issues, zero ZPA connectivity (cannot access any App seg when using this option) until the user authenticates for ZPA. This does breaks some our management tools ....so the general ZPA Timeout Policy offers more flexibility.

SharonCM

(Partner)

2 years ago

thank you for the detailed answer. very helpful

1 like

catherinejohn3

(Customer)

2 years ago

Unmanaged devices limiting connection after each restart? This recurring issue might indicate a lack of device management protocols or network configuration settings.

best bundle deals for tv internet and cell phone

To address it, consider implementing access control lists (ACLs) or network segmentation to regulate device access. Additionally, deploying network monitoring tools can help identify unauthorized devices and prevent them from disrupting network functionality. Regular audits and updates to network policies can mitigate such connectivity issues in the future.

Cows_with_JetPacks

(Customer) asked a question.

June 21, 2024 at 3:53 PM

Randomly getting 'ZScaler root certificate not installed' browser errors for some users

Every now and then we will get a user that runs into this issue when trying to browse to a website (see screenshot below). The same issue would happen at my previous employer as well - completely different environment. This occurs with random users at random times - maybe 2 -3 users per month out of 1000.

We have verified that the ZScaler root certificate is installed in the Trusted Root Certification Authorities store and up-to-date.

Manually reinstalling the ZScaler root certificate and rebooting the machine resolves the issue.

Has anyone else encountered this issue? If so, have you found a permanent fix?

Thanks in advance.

ZIA - Forwarding

(Customer)

2 years ago

LOL thanks! 😋

ZCC is running on the endpoint.  v4.4.0.300

Windows 11 but I've seen it happen on Windows 10 as well.

CKAIJA

(Employee)

2 years ago

I would look to the Browser cache ---- and SSL state setting --- it is providing the old SSL interception certificate from the browser cache more then likely ---- for this site ---

Go into incognito or InPrivate Browsing --- open

cnn.com

-------- look at the SSL cert for the site  ---- it should show two and they should be signed by the Zscaler intermediate   --- one the top one is certificate signing for your client browser -- the second it --- certificate emulating --- hence the (t)  at the end of the Cert --  check the validity dates for the Certs in play ===== if it is working right it should be valid for 14 days ---- Issued OnFriday, June 14, 2024 at 11:45:07 PM          Expires OnFriday, June 28, 2024 at 11:45:07 PM ------ if you want to test is clear the browser cache  ---- cookies and site data /  cached images and files /  and set the time frame all time -----

1 like

CKAIJA

(Employee)

2 years ago

All modern browsers have management options to Delete this data in the browsers on a timer--- or on action say close browser -------

There is no cache for you to worry about since the CACHE is on on Data Center Proxies and not your DC so why save this data on your browser

Ramesh M

hyminameisderek

(Customer)

a year ago

It's been a year but was there any ever resolution found for this? We experience this exact issue and it is very random. The user can open ZCC, do a restart service and update policy and the issue is resolved.

It happens randomly so it is hard to repeat and identify root cause.

hyminameisderek

(Customer)

a year ago

for what it's worth. This happened to a user today and I was able to dig in a little bit before our Support Team resolved it.

Error appeared in Chrome.

Browsing was fine in Edge

Validated ZScaler cert was in root store

Validated issued certificate, intermediate cert (t), root cert - all valid in the Chrome session that was reporting the error

cleared browser cache, tried incognito.

Validated user had proper App Profile

Error persists in Chrome until a Policy Update and Restart Service is issued in ZCC.

We are working with our TAM on this as well but thought I'd share some insight based on what I was able to capture today.

Cows_with_JetPacks

(Customer)

a year ago

We were never able to determine the root cause of the issue, but we did find @Christopher Kaija​ 's suggestion regarding the SSL State helpful.

We work around the issue by clearing the SSL State in Internet Options > Content > Clear SSL State. After that, the issue is resolved.
